summary: Frontend-only UI validation of paneltec-v160.3.9.32-4c.2 multi-hot-patch (Users & Permissions bugs 1-5 + regression 6). Logged in as stephen@paneltec.com.au on the preview URL and exercised the Users page, Users→Dashboard tab, User drawer, row Access kebab, SimproImportPickerModal, and Workers page. 10 of 11 checks PASS. One CRITICAL finding on BUG 3: the SimproImportPickerModal is stuck on 'Loading Simpro employees…' with 0 selected · 0 shown · 0 total even after 10s, so the empty-state / 2-row / toggle-to-66 flow cannot be observed. In addition, the X close button (data-testid='simpro-picker-close') click does not actually close the modal even with force=True (modal stays visible in DOM). ESC key + backdrop click paths could not be fully verified because subsequent picker reopen attempts were blocked by the still-open modal intercepting pointer events.

minor.issue: Endpoint returns 200 in backend logs, but the SimproImportPickerModal never renders any rows (frontend appears to stay in loading=true). Baseline expected: 2 rows with include_linked=false, 66 rows with include_linked=true (64 marked 'Imported'). Actual observed: 0/0/0.

ui_bugs.issue: Modal is stuck on 'Loading Simpro employees…' with 0 selected · 0 shown · 0 total. Rows never appear (waited up to 10s). BUG 3 empty-state / includeLinked toggle flow cannot be validated.

Clicking [data-testid='simpro-picker-close'] (even with playwright force=True) does not close the modal — after click, the modal container is still present in the DOM and continues to intercept pointer events on the underlying page. onClose prop wired to the button in code (line 117), so likely a parent-state or event-propagation issue.

integration_issues.flow: Simpro import picker → list available employees
integration_issues.issue: Frontend loading state never transitions to loaded state despite backend returning 200 on /api/admin/simpro/employees/available. Possible causes: response shape mismatch, api client base-URL issue, or an error being swallowed by toast.error()

issues: Metric card still labelled 'INVITE PENDING' (value 0). Not user-actionable but keeps the 'invite' vocabulary alive after the invite-affordance sweep. Consider renaming to 'PENDING ACTIVATION' for consistency with the segmented count header.
Every worker row shows an 'INVITE PENDING' status pill under their existing ACTIVE badge. Same vocabulary concern as above — may or may not be in scope for the invite sweep.

action_items: Investigate why SimproImportPickerModal stays in loading state despite backend 200 (check api client base URL, response parsing of data.employees, and swallowed errors).
Fix X-close button (data-testid='simpro-picker-close') so it actually closes the modal — event may be intercepted by the AppShell sticky header (z-index) or onClose prop is not toggling parent state.
Consider renaming 'INVITE PENDING' metric/pills to 'PENDING ACTIVATION' to complete the invite-affordance sweep vocabulary.
Baseline drift: request said 48 pending_activation users, live count is 47 (banner reads '47 imported users are waiting…'). Update expected value in playbook.
critical_code_review_comments: SimproImportPickerModal.jsx line 25-38: setLoading(false) is in finally block so a swallowed exception in the response transform would still exit loading — but observed stuck-loading suggests the useEffect may not be running or `api.get` is not resolving. Add a console.error in the catch and a data-testid='simpro-picker-empty' / 'simpro-picker-error' for observability.

SimproImportPickerModal.jsx line 105 backdrop uses `<div className="absolute inset-0 bg-slate-900/40" onClick={onClose} />` (fine). The X close button (line 117) also just calls onClose. If onClose is not toggling the parent state, both would fail together — but the ESC pathway also uses onClose (line 42). Suggest logging in UsersManagement.jsx `setSimproPickerOpen` to confirm state transitions.

UsersManagement.jsx line 497 banner text hard-codes 'imported users are waiting for role assignment' — the pending-users-hint banner does show a count of pending users and 'Show pending users only →' link (data-testid works), but review request template suggested the copy may differ. Confirm final wording with product owner.
